Two components in the patient chart import `UserIcon` from `@openmrs/esm-framework` and render it. Both use it only as a decorative icon inside an `InfoTooltip`, so a behaviour change in the icon would show up in the orderer tooltip of each.

1. **`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-medications-app/src/components/medications-details-table.component.tsx`**: `UserIcon` is imported at line 48 and rendered at line 379 inside `InfoTooltip` (lines 376–382). The tooltip is an `IconButton` that shows the orderer label, so any change to rendering, sizing or accessibility would affect it.
2. **`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-orders-app/src/components/medication-record.component.tsx`**: `UserIcon` is imported at line 5 and rendered at line 110 inside `InfoTooltip` (lines 105–117). This one wraps the icon in a `ToggletipButton` with an "Orderer information" label, so it depends on the icon forwarding its props and ref correctly.

The upstream definition is in `openmrs-esm-core`. It is a `memo(forwardRef(...))` wrapper around the shared `Icon` component, using the `omrs-icon-user` glyph and passing `props` through as `iconProps`. Both chart call sites pass `size={16}` and depend on that prop handling. The `mock.tsx` and `mock-jest.tsx` stubs are test doubles and do not affect the production chart, but they would drift from a behaviour change and are listed for completeness.
